gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an aggregate prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 18.6 million in 2019. This comprised a GBP 5.8 million strengthening for the 2017 and prior years of account, driven by negative specific large loss experience in political risk, D&O, and energy classes. For the 2018 year of account, there was a GBP 12.8 million strengthening, primarily due to gross reserve strengthening in cargo, energy, and political risk classes, and several specific large losses from downstream energy exposures, partially offset by reserve releases in marine liability and cyber classes.

Overall prior-year development was effectively flat (no material net release or strengthening identified from the claims development tables), with the report noting favourable movement in 2016 & prior reserves offset by adverse large loss experience on classes such as political risk, D&O and energy. Marine liability and cyber showed reserve releases in parts of the portfolio, while cargo/hull, energy and political risk experienced strengthening in the year.
